Feature.Description: ILCS device task contract in SiLA 2 form. Actions are submitted and then polled by the ILCS CommandId; the device never needs to know about batches or workflows. Submit returns as soon as the device has accepted (or rejected) the task; long-running work is observed through QueryTask. Implemented only by devices that take part in automatic workflows.

Command.Description: Submit an action. Returns state accepted/running when the device has taken the task, done when it finished synchronously.

Parameter.Description: Stable command identifier issued by ILCS. A device that implements de-duplication MUST return the existing task for a repeated CommandId instead of acting twice.
JSON object of step parameters, as described by the capability's ParametersSchema in TaskSupport. Matrix plans add params.wells = {well: {param: value}}.

JSON object: batch_id, step_index, step_id, target_command_id, station_id; method {id, code, version, name, program} when the step uses a device method (program selects the device-side program); material {name, unit, param} when the step doses a material (the dosed amount is params[param]; report the actual amount in delivered.materials under that name). Unknown keys MUST be ignored; wells is reserved for detection steps.

Response.Description: JSON receipt: command_id (echo), state (accepted|running|done|failed|unknown|not_found), device_ts (ISO-8601 with offset), quality (good|bad|uncertain), delivered (object; delivered.materials lists actual material consumption), telemetry (list of {metric, value, setpoint}), error (string).

Command.Description: Return the current receipt of a task by the ILCS CommandId; state not_found if the device never saw it.

Parameter.Description: Stable command identifier issued by ILCS. A device that implements de-duplication MUST return the existing task for a repeated CommandId instead of acting twice.

Response.Description: JSON receipt: command_id (echo), state (accepted|running|done|failed|unknown|not_found), device_ts (ISO-8601 with offset), quality (good|bad|uncertain), delivered (object; delivered.materials lists actual material consumption), telemetry (list of {metric, value, setpoint}), error (string).

Command.Description: Hold the in-flight action named by TargetCommandId.

Parameter.Description: Stable command identifier issued by ILCS. A device that implements de-duplication MUST return the existing task for a repeated CommandId instead of acting twice.
The in-flight action command this control request applies to.

Response.Description: JSON receipt: command_id (echo), state (accepted|running|done|failed|unknown|not_found), device_ts (ISO-8601 with offset), quality (good|bad|uncertain), delivered (object; delivered.materials lists actual material consumption), telemetry (list of {metric, value, setpoint}), error (string).

Command.Description: Abort the in-flight action named by TargetCommandId and bring the device to a safe state.

Parameter.Description: Stable command identifier issued by ILCS. A device that implements de-duplication MUST return the existing task for a repeated CommandId instead of acting twice.
The in-flight action command this control request applies to.

Response.Description: JSON receipt: command_id (echo), state (accepted|running|done|failed|unknown|not_found), device_ts (ISO-8601 with offset), quality (good|bad|uncertain), delivered (object; delivered.materials lists actual material consumption), telemetry (list of {metric, value, setpoint}), error (string).

Property.Description: JSON object: device_id, model, serial, firmware, simulator (true only for simulated devices), interlock (bool), accepts_commands (bool), device_ts. Kept for version 1.0 clients; devices that also implement DeviceInfo report the same facts there.

Which capabilities the device runs through this feature and which controls it supports. Served from the driver configuration, so it stays readable while the device is offline. Added in version 1.1; ILCS falls back to the support flags registered for the station when a version 1.0 device does not have it.

DefinedExecutionError.Description: Parameters are outside the device limits or malformed. The device did not act.
A safety interlock is active. The device did not act.
No free channel or slot. The device did not act.
The device does not support this capability, program or control. The device did not act.

The driver host could not reach the device before doing anything: the device did not act. Raised by QueryTask it means the device cannot be asked right now; ILCS asks again later. A request that may have reached the device MUST NOT be reported with this error.

DataTypeDefinition.Description: Capabilities and controls offered through TaskExecution.

Element.Description: HoldTask holds a running action and dispatch with TaskType resume continues it.
AbortTask stops a running action and brings the device to a safe state.
QueryTask answers reliably by CommandId, also after the driver host restarts.
A repeated CommandId returns the existing task without acting twice.

sync: SubmitTask returns only after the device accepted or refused the task. async: SubmitTask only hands the task over (e.g. writes a start edge); a refusal (busy, interlock) shows up later through QueryTask.
ILCS capability identifier, e.g. cap.plc_run; * (simulators only) accepts any capability.

JSON Schema of the parameters the device accepts for this capability: an object schema whose properties give type, unit (annotation), minimum / maximum or enum. Parameters not listed are refused, never silently dropped. ILCS cross-checks it against its capability dictionary and station limits; it does not replace them.
Device-side programs (device methods) usable with this capability; a single entry * accepts any program; empty when the capability has no programs.
Program identifier as ILCS sends it in ContextJson method.program.
